description:
The process starts when an employee or department submits a request for an IT solution, such as new software or hardware.
IT assesses the request, checking for compatibility with existing systems and evaluating cost and resource needs.
If approved, IT procures the necessary tools or licenses, installs the solution, and tests it in a controlled environment.
After successful testing, the new solution is rolled out to the requesting department.
Training may be provided, and IT support remains available for troubleshooting.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/it-solution-request">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ITSolutionRequest" name="IT solution request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Main">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Requester" name="Employee or department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_RequestProcess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_IT" name="IT">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssessRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Approval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcureTools</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InstallSolution</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TestSolution</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RollOut</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Training</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideTraining</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TrainingMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MakeSupportAvailable</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_SupportAvailable</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_UnspecifiedOutcome</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RequestProcess" name="Request process triggered">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Submit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitRequest" name="Submit IT solution request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Submit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Submit_Assess</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssessRequest" name="Assess compatibility, cost, and resource needs">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Submit_Assess</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Assess_Approval</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval" name="Request approved?" default="Flow_NotApproved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Assess_Approval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcureTools" name="Procure necessary tools or licenses">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Procure_Install</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InstallSolution" name="Install solution">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Procure_Install</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Install_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSolution" name="Test solution in a controlled environment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Install_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_RollOut</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RollOut" name="Roll out solution to requesting department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_RollOut</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RollOut_Training</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Training" name="Provide training?" default="Flow_NoTraining">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RollOut_Training</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ProvideTraining</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoTraining</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideTraining" name="Provide training">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ProvideTraining</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training_TrainingMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TrainingMerge" name="Merge training paths">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Training_TrainingMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoTraining</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainingMerge_Support</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeSupportAvailable" name="Keep IT support available for troubleshooting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainingMerge_Support</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Support_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SupportAvailable" name="IT support remains available for troubleshooting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Support_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_UnspecifiedOutcome">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotApproved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Submit" sourceRef="StartEvent_RequestProcess" targetRef="Task_SubmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_Assess" sourceRef="Task_SubmitRequest" targetRef="Task_AssessRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assess_Approval" sourceRef="Task_AssessRequest" targetRef="Gateway_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="Task_ProcureTools">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">approved = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotApproved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="EndEvent_UnspecifiedOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Procure_Install" sourceRef="Task_ProcureTools" targetRef="Task_InstallSolution"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Install_Test" sourceRef="Task_InstallSolution" targetRef="Task_TestSolution"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_RollOut" sourceRef="Task_TestSolution" targetRef="Task_RollOut"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RollOut_Training" sourceRef="Task_RollOut" targetRef="Gateway_Training"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProvideTraining" sourceRef="Gateway_Training" targetRef="Task_ProvideTraining">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">trainingProvided = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoTraining" sourceRef="Gateway_Training" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_TrainingMerge" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTraining" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingMerge_Support" sourceRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge" targetRef="Task_MakeSupportAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Support_End" sourceRef="Task_MakeSupportAvailable" targetRef="EndEvent_SupportAvailable"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
